purpose: Create source-only eye-internal variants whose four Daily gaze directions remain readable at native 200x200; do not replace the locked V9 static baseline.

reference.usage: The locked V9 image is the only identity reference supplied to the image generator.

output_contract.format: single 2x2 source sheet with four labelled-by-order, unlabelled-in-image 200x200 face cells: left, right, up, down
output_contract.pixel_intent: clean monochrome black ink on white, no grey, color, texture or shading
output_contract.allowed_change: only the internal white highlight and small sparkle geometry inside the two existing open black eye silhouettes

directional_readability.left: both eyes place a large white gaze light toward image-left and a smaller companion sparkle that reinforces image-left
directional_readability.right: mirror of left, clearly toward image-right
directional_readability.up: both eyes place the large white gaze light high inside the fixed eye body with the companion sparkle also above the eye midpoint
directional_readability.down: both eyes place the large white gaze light low inside the fixed eye body with the companion sparkle also below the eye midpoint

forbidden: replace or edit the locked V9 source file
new outer eye silhouette or eye size
new face, brow, mouth, cheek or charm art
full-face runtime frames or a whole-face animation loop
legacy art, custom LUT, code-drawn eye, candidate activation, provisioning or firmware flash
required_machine_gates_before_use: generated source SHA256 and lineage record
outer-eye silhouette/identity comparison against locked V9
